title: Mob Nudge
description: This Mod adds a simple way to move mobs through the use of commands by pixels.
body:
Mob Nudge is Mod that lets you nudge mobs by the pixel to relocate without having to teleport or resummon them.

DISCLAMER: this only works with Operator Permisions and the command is /nudge X Y Z. 

Comment if there is anything you would like to add
